findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed there was an accumulation of debris in the soda gun holders at the bar. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of debris. The PIC began the process of washing, rinsing, and sanitizing the holders during the inspection. Ensure that the soda gun holders remain clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM PREVIOUS INSPECTION PERFORMED ON 12/20/2021. 

Inspector observed both the ice bin upper baffle and the soda gun holder to be soiled with mold during the inspection. Food-contact surfaces such as these are required to be cleaned AND sanitized often enough to prevent such accumulations from occurring. Inspector discussed routine wiping of the baffle of the ice machine between professional servicing to prevent such growth. Ensure that food-contact surfaces remain cleaned and sanitized. A follow-up has been issued for 01/04/2024 to check the ice bin and soda guns. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed nozzle on soda gun to be soiled with brown debris. Ensure nozzles are cleaned as necessary to prevent debris build-up.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed black debris on sides of ice machine. Ensure ice machine is cleaned as needed to prevent build-up.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Observed food equipment inside handsink. All handwashing stations must be accessible to employees at all times.
750-1120(b) Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed chlorine test strips at the bar. Bar uses quat as their sanitizer in the three compartment sink. Ensure that the proper test strips are provided to test the concentration of sanitizer solution.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the following food contact surfaces to be soiled: (1) the soda guns to be soiled with a heavy accumulation of what appears to be mold and food debris, (2) the can opener and other food equipment such as knives and spoons stored in cups soiled with dust and food debris, and (3) the ice deflector shield of the ice machine in the basement with what appears to be mold and dust. Clean and maintain food contact surfaces to prevent cross contamination.750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to be soiled: (1) the exterior of a bottle of caramel stored in the bar reach in cooler with what appears to be mold and dust and (2) the bottom of the soda gun holders at the bar with what appears to be mold, standing water, and insect pupae. Clean and maintain non-food contact surfaces.750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Observed unwrapped straws stored on the bar within distance of coughs,  sneezing, and talking. Straws should be protected in a dispenser, wrapper, or be placed behind the bar to prevent contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or the mouth of the user.  Single service items shall be protected at all times from contamination.750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: REPEAT VIOLATION: Absence of thermometer to cooling unit with orange juice and milk. Provide thermometer.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed a gap in between the wall and the women's restroom sink and the men's urinal and the wall.Caulk the area between the sinkand wall.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
